errors.text_span: 大多数柱状图的高度位于20到80之间
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect and misrepresents the data distribution. A large number of bars have values below 10, and several prominent bars have values at or above 100 (the highest being around 500-600). The data shows a long-tail distribution, not a concentration in the 20-80 range.
The label for the rightmost bar in the chart is 'A/n-Hn/s', not 'A/Hn-s'.
The height of the rightmost bar ('A/n-Hn/s') is much lower than 5. On the logarithmic scale, it is very close to the baseline of 1, likely representing a value of 1 or 2.
The height of the leftmost bar ('O/s') is approximately 40-50 on the logarithmic scale, not 30. While an approximation, 30 is a notable underestimate.
